subject.title: docs(plan): propose server-bound egress session identity

question: Should the maintained egress documentation include this explicitly unresolved server-bound identity proposal as the recorded future direction?
rationale: The patch is documentation-only and accurately separates current behavior from the proposal, but deciding whether an incomplete protocol design belongs in the maintained plan surface is a maintainer product and documentation-policy choice.

options.title: Keep as a guarded plan document
options.body: Merge the proposal with its current non-implementable status and open-problem caveats so future egress work has a documented starting point.

options.title: Hold until transition semantics are resolved
options.body: Keep the analysis outside the maintained docs until a complete legacy/server-bound rollout design and validation plan are ready.

recommendation.title: Keep as a guarded plan document
recommendation.body: Merge the proposal with its current non-implementable status and open-problem caveats so future egress work has a documented starting point.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged tombstone mechanism and authored the follow-up design analysis, making them the strongest available routing candidate for clarifying the intended plan status.
